rounds.notes: First WEC visit; replaced the cancelled Qatar/Bahrain rounds. Race started on a wet track (fiawec.com).

cancelled.notes: Season opener postponed from March; then cancelled (FIA/ACO announcement 28 Jul 2026: regional developments in the Middle East affecting freight and travel). Replaced by Barcelona.
Cancelled for the same reason (28 Jul 2026 announcement); replaced by Monza 6-8 Nov. Stale fiawec.com event pages still show Qatar 22-24 Oct and Bahrain 5-7 Nov 2026.

bop.notes: From 2026 the FIA/ACO no longer publish the per-round Balance of Performance tables (weight, power, energy/stint); they are shared only with the competitors (announced at the Imola media briefing). No BoP document appears on the Al Kamel WEC noticeboard for 2026. Only the driver-weight compensation ballast rules are public (committee decisions WEC_2026_D06 / D13).
